commands.name: StartSlaReportGeneration
steps: resolve Daily/Weekly/Monthly/selected-range boundaries in fixed America/Guayaquil and canonical UTC; validate optional Customer scope and output extension/path
capture canonical as_of_utc
inside short UoW insert receipt/report_attempt state=staging and one durable LLD-01 report job ref containing only bounded attempt/scope/destination tokens
audit start and commit
worker begins REPORT_SNAPSHOT_V1
rules: start does not create completed evidence or alter operational state
selected range is a progress/report view over canonical monthly cohorts, not a new contractual cohort definition

commands.name: StageReportSnapshotBatch
steps: require at least one row; validate exact section schemas, canonical row ordering, payload hashes and batch_payload_sha256 outside writer lock

inside bounded UoW resolve command receipt first: exact committed command_id/command_type/request_hash replay returns the original ReportSnapshotBatchResultV1 before stale-revision checks; any mismatch is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT
revalidate attempt=staging, expected revision and exact current durable-job snapshot_generation_token
insert one command receipt before any attempt-owned staging row or last_command_id reference
insert only normalized/minimized report snapshot rows produced by the still-open stable accepted-state reader
update exact member/cohort/section counters, attempt revision and last_command_id; construct ReportSnapshotBatchResultV1 and commit atomically
rules: the durable worker assigns one UUID command_id to the exact generation/batch before first invocation and reuses it for every retry of that same batch
COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 binds report_attempt_id, generation token, batch ordinal, canonical batch hash, expected revision and normalized row content
batch never reads live domain state itself and cannot mutate SR/classification/policy/contributor authority
rollback removes receipt, rows, counters and revision together; a committed replay cannot duplicate rows or counters

commands.name: SealReportSnapshot
steps: inside UoW require attempt=staging
recompute persisted child counts/order/hash across SLA and registered section rows plus exact report request metadata
mismatch fails closed
set snapshot_hash/all counts/state=ready_to_generate/revision
audit bounded snapshot seal and commit
rules: stable read snapshot must remain logically complete through contributor EOF before sealing

commands.name: MarkReportGenerating
steps: inside UoW require ready_to_generate
insert/reuse job command receipt
transition generating/revision/audit and commit
commands.rule: XLSX writer subsequently reads only sealed staged snapshot rows

commands.name: MarkReportVerifying
steps: inside UoW require generating and sealed snapshot
transition verifying/revision/audit and commit
verification occurs outside writer transaction by reopening candidate artifact and checking required structure/content snapshot hash

commands.name: CompleteSlaReport
steps: inside UoW require state=verifying and exact sealed snapshot hash
require verification VALID and nonempty artifact
recompute exact staged member/tier/cohort/section counts and immutable policy/classification/source/section schema references
insert/reuse receipt
set artifact filename/hash/size/verified_at/state=completed/completed_at/revision
append completion audit/result refs and commit
rules: this transaction is the authority transition: all staged snapshot rows become immutable CompletedReportEvidence
later operational/policy/contact/customer/contributor changes never update completed attempt or child rows

commands.name: FailSlaReportAttempt
steps: inside UoW require not completed
insert/reuse receipt
delete only attempt-owned staged SLA member/tier/cohort and report_section_snapshots rows while they are non-authoritative
set attempt failed/failure_code/completed_at/revision and clear snapshot/artifact candidate metadata not proven completed plus staged counts
audit bounded failure and commit
best-effort delete temporary external candidate through filesystem adapter outside domain transaction
rules: failed attempt retains no complete report snapshot population
failure never changes operational records/classification/policy/contributor data
temporary-file deletion failure is diagnostic housekeeping, not completed report evidence

commands.name: CancelSlaReportAttempt
steps: request durable job cancellation at a safe boundary

once worker is outside artifact finalization/completed transition, inside UoW insert receipt/delete all non-authoritative staged SLA and registered-section children/set counters zero/state cancelled/completed_at/revision/audit/commit
clean temporary artifact best-effort outside transaction
rules: cancellation creates no completed evidence and no operational cleanup

worker_recovery: startup resumes report jobs only from committed attempt state and sealed snapshot metadata

staging attempt with interrupted stable-read generation cannot guess completeness; discard all staged child rows through Fail/restart path or rebuild from a new attempt according to durable-job policy
ready_to_generate/generating may regenerate artifact deterministically from sealed snapshot
verifying may reverify an existing candidate only when destination token/candidate identity is exact and safe; otherwise regenerate from sealed snapshot
completed attempts are never regenerated into changed evidence; optional re-export of a completed snapshot is a distinct future/explicit artifact action and does not alter evidence
